## Deliver
Write one `creative-evidence` record per (i) card that is finished, abandoned or reaches the iteration cap: route (provider, model, level, rung, ladder version, dial position), course (iterations, cap reached, visual verdict per iteration), full-lifecycle cost from ED-5, per-dimension scores with rater `automatic`, `agent` or `operator` and the grader route, and blind pairwise picks as winner and loser route. Export the records to Token Economy for TE-83 through the existing package seam, with a versioned schema. Compute grader calibration per dimension: agent scores count as ladder evidence only while they lie within one point of the operator's on at least 80 percent of the last 20 jointly rated cards; report the state per dimension. Report first-iteration finish rate and pairwise standing per route with sample size; mark a rung change as supported only after at least 20 comparisons with an interval that excludes parity. Add an operator command for the Dossier's creative quality batch: twelve fixture briefs run with explicit pins as Sonnet 5.5 high against Opus 5.5 low, and the 3D subset as Sonnet 5.5 max against Opus 5.5 max, feeding the blind comparison of ED-10.

## Out of scope
Changing the creative ladder itself (Token Economy decides from the evidence), running the batch on production accounts.

## Acceptance
- Fixture ledgers prove the record content, the rater labels, the calibration rule and the 20-comparison threshold.
- The export validates against its schema and contains no figure without its rater and sample size.
- A dry run of the batch command against fixtures produces paired runs and a pending comparison list.

## Rules
Reproduce each gap with a failing test before the fix. Tests inject the clock (TestClockGuardTests). Every ProcessStartInfo sets CreateNoWindow = true. No empty catch blocks, no whole-file line-ending rewrites. Orchestration transition rules stay in orchestration-decisions/; hosts collect facts and apply returned decisions. Do not commit, push or manage worktrees; the platform owns git. Report the result SHA in results/status.md.
